propositions: When re-reviewing a BLOCK verdict with persisting blocking findings, a deterministic pre-check must warn if the plan text containing all cited evidence anchors is unchanged since the blocking review.
The warning is warn-only and never hard-blocks, declines, or changes exit code, because ~8% of BLOCK→PASS transitions occur with no material change (verdict flap).

The pre-check fires only when the latest sidecar verdict is BLOCK with blocking findings, the description component fingerprint is unchanged, and at least one cited anchor matches verbatim in the current plan.
Findings with unmatchable or paraphrased anchors never trigger the warning alone; warning requires at least one matched anchor with all matched anchors untouched.
The precheck.cited_anchor_warning flag is recorded in sidecar metrics on every review (true or false) to measure warning hit rate and predictive value offline.
